blocks.text: Direct Recruitment Cell (E-III), Conference Hall, Old Secretariat, Civil Lines
Near Vidhan Sabha, New Delhi, Delhi, Pincode - 110054
Sub: Offer of appointment to the post of TGT (ENGLISH) (Male/Female)/TGT (ENGLISH) under the Post Code: 804/24.

In pursuance of DSSSB Result Notice No. 192 dated - 28.07.2026 of the post code mentioned above in the subject matter. Sh./Smt./Km. UDAI KISHAN MANDAWAT (DoB - 6.10.2002), (Roll No. 248041201000444) a nominee of the Delhi Subordinate Service Selection Board (DSSSB) is hereby given an offer to a temporary post of TGT (ENGLISH) (Male/Female)/TGT (ENGLISH) in the pay scale of Rs. 9300-34800, Grade Pay - 4600/- (Pre-revised) plus usual allowances as admissible under the rules. This appointment is subject to the following terms and conditions:-

1. That this offer of appointment is subject to successful verification of the following original documents in respect of educational/professional qualifications, age, experience where prescribed, caste/category/EWS/OBC/PwBD certificates and other necessary documents:-

a. Date of Birth.
b. Educational Qualification, NOC etc.
c. Category, Status, Caste/Tribe Certificate.
d. Disability certificate.
During the verification or at any later stage/period of service, if any discrepancy is found, this offer of appointment shall stand cancelled without assigning any reason.

2. That the candidates shall be required to produce their original documents at the time of Document Verification and shall remain subject to verification of the genuineness and correctness of all documents/certificates furnished by them.
3. That issuance of this offer of appointment shall be provisional and shall not amount to final acceptance of the candidature or confirmation of eligibility of the candidate.
4. That detailed scrutiny/verification of the dossiers and original documents shall be undertaken subsequently at the stage of Document Verification (DV) and/or at the appropriate stage of appointment.
5. That mere issuance of an offer of appointment shall not confer any vested or indefeasible right upon a candidate for appointment, if the candidate is subsequently found ineligible or otherwise unsuitable in terms of the applicable rules/instructions.
6. That the offer of appointment is purely on temporary basis and the candidate will be on Probation for a period of two years which can further be extended at the discretion of the Appointing Authority. The appointment is likely to be made regular only on successful completion of probation.
7. That the appointment will be further subject to his/her being declared medically fit by the Competent Authority and the verification of his/her character and antecedents and all other essential qualifications.
8. That if he/she is found ineligible for the said post in accordance with its Recruitment Rules framed by the department, Government instructions, advertisement conditions or other terms and conditions governing appointment even after the issuance of this offer of appointment, the candidature/offer of appointment shall be liable to be rejected/cancelled, as the case may be.
9. That he/she will have to produce the original certificate regarding his/her belonging to SC/ST/OBC and physically handicapped wherever applicable for any claim in respect of age relaxation, before the Appointing Authority.
10. That the appointment shall be subject to the general orders and terms and conditions made/issued by the Administrator of NCT of Delhi.
11. That the appointee is liable to be posted in any school run by Directorate of Education, Govt. of National Capital Territory of Delhi.
12. That he/she will also produce original testimonials in support of his/her education, academic and technical qualifications that render him/her qualified for appointment on the said post at the time of formal appointment.
13. That appointment may be terminated at any time by giving one month's notice from either side viz the appointee or the Appointing Authority, without assigning any reason. The Appointing Authority, however, reserves the right of terminating the services of the appointee forthwith or before the expiry of stipulated period of notice by making payment to him/her a sum equivalent to the pay and allowances for the period of notice or the unexpired portion thereto.
14. That the appointment is provisional and is subject to the caste certificate being verified through the proper channels. If the verification reveals that the claim of the candidate for belonging to Other Backward Classes/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe as the case may be or for not belonging to Creamy Layer in Other Backward Class is false, his/her services will be terminated forthwith without assigning any further reasons and without prejudice to such further action as may be taken under the provisions of Indian Panel Code for production of false certificate (As per DOPT OM No. 36033/4/97-Estt (Res) dated 25 July 2003).
15. That the appointment will be further subject to:

a. Submission of declaration in the form enclosed and in the event of his/her having more than one living wife/husband his/her appointment will be subject to his/her exemption from the enforcement of the rules in this regard.
b. Taking oath of allegiance of faithfulness of the constitution of India or making a solemn affirmation to the effect in the enclosed performa.
16. That he/she will submit an undertaking to the effect that he/she has not been debarred by any Board/University/Commission in any examination.
